_comment: Herald staff for bylines. 'from'/'to' are years on staff; a story's byline must be someone on staff that year. Canon people: Orozaliev, Hendricks, Beishenova, Erkin Bolot uulu. The rest are minor invented staff.

staff.name: Medet Orozaliev
staff.bio: Former Iradyn Chyny correspondent; co-founded the Herald in March 1993 and edited it until 2009. Author of Twenty Years of Deadlines (2013).

staff.name: Margaret Hendricks
staff.bio: American reporter who covered Operation Starlight and the siege of Talas for a Chicago paper; co-founder and managing editor until 2001.

staff.name: Erkin Bolot uulu
staff.bio: City reporter and photographer. Held for ten days in October 2023 while photographing a march; released without charge.

staff.name: Daniel Whitcomb
staff.bio: Covered the Territorial Legislature and the air base economy until the end of the territorial period.

staff.name: Sergei Lysenko
staff.bio: The Herald's first Nurzhan correspondent: refinery, railway and the Labor council.

staff.name: Olga Fedorenko
staff.bio: Runs the Nurzhan bureau: NurGaz, the council, heating and the city's Russian-speaking life.

staff.name: Nadia Osmonalieva
staff.bio: Covers the Mejlis, the Election Commission and Government House.

staff.name: Timur Sadyrbaev
staff.bio: Energy, beef, banking, trucking and the som.

staff.name: Kubat Duishenaliev
staff.bio: Covers the six districts, the line and, where he can get permits, the tribal regions.

staff.name: Aigerim Tokonova
staff.bio: Music, film, books, food and the language revival.

staff.name: Rosa Zhakypova
staff.bio: Football, ulak tartysh and the hippodrome.

staff.name: Aidai Kurmanalieva
staff.bio: Founding editor of Jarchy, the Herald's Iradi-language weekly.

staff.name: Talgat Murzaliev
staff.bio: Economist at Talas State University; writes a fortnightly column on money and work.
